Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Yard-Dyed Shibori Decorative Throw Pillow Cover, 17" x 17", Blue
Colors: Blue
Varying shades of indigo and white stripes bring a shibori-inspired, global touch to any style room. The yarn-dyed woven pattern is the same on the front and back of this throw pillow cover, adding a pleasing texture to living room furniture or a bed. 17" x 17" Cover is 100% Polyester Insert not included Pillow cover features a zipper closure Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry.
